sequence_recommendation: 1. Impeccable critique: isolated A/B with design assessment before detector/browser evidence; retain target/ignore/provenance; narrow viewport/motion scope to user limits.
2. Impeccable audit: separate technical score /20, P0–P3 severity and verified evidence.
3. Ponytail review for the current branch/change; ponytail audit only if whole-repo coverage is intended.

4. Motion: review-animations on actual motion changes; improve-animations for a broad motion audit/roadmap. Apple-design only for actual gesture controls. MotionScore audit cannot run without the unavailable Motion+ MCP. Use performance diagnostics only for measured symptoms; break-ui only for a concrete data-driven component.
5. Apply evidence-backed fixes with current owners, then recheck affected findings once. Use only scores defined by each skill.
